summary.title: Handoff summary
summary.subtitle: Check every line before the summary goes with a referral.
summary.startBody: AI can draft a summary from the facts in this case. You check every line, then approve or reject it. Nothing is used until you approve it.
summary.aiNote: AI used only the facts in this case. It cannot send anything, change urgency or edit the record.
summary.checkNone: The draft reported nothing missing or conflicting.
summary.keptWho: Your name, the time, and whether you approved or rejected it
summary.keptText: The text you approve, with every change you make
summary.keptModel: The AI version that drafted it: {model}, prompt {prompt}
summary.keptNote: Approving does not send a referral. You send it from your hospital system, with the approved summary attached.
summary.approveDialogBody: It goes with the referral when you send it from your hospital system.
summary.rejectHelp: Your reason is kept with the draft and helps the team improve what AI writes.
summary.rejectedToast: Draft rejected. Your reason is kept with it.
summary.approvedNext: Send the referral from your hospital system, with this summary attached.
summary.rejectedNext: Write the summary yourself in your hospital system and attach it to the referral.

noDraft.conflict: AI drafting is switched off, or this case already has an approved summary.
noDraft.unavailable: The AI service did not produce a draft it could check.
noDraft.error: The service is off or did not answer.

summary.noDraftBody: CareLoop cannot take a summary you write yourself yet. Write it in your hospital system and attach it to the referral. Every other step still works.

decisionFailed.forbidden: Only a clinician can approve or reject this summary.
decisionFailed.conflict: This draft was already decided or replaced, so your decision was not saved.
decisionFailed.notAvailable: Saving a decision is not available yet.
decisionFailed.notFound: This draft no longer exists, so your decision was not saved.
decisionFailed.invalid: The decision could not be saved. Check the text and try again.
decisionFailed.error: Your decision could not be saved. Try again.

summary.clinicianOnly: Only clinicians approve handoff summaries. {name} is responsible for this case.
summary.clinicianOnlyYou: Only clinicians approve handoff summaries. You are responsible for this case.

impact.methodBody: We replay the same cases twice: once with reminders and escalation, and once without them. Everything else stays the same, so the difference shows what reminders and escalation change. It shows how CareLoop works; it is not evidence of real-world results.
impact.comparisonUnavailableTitle: The comparison isn't available right now
impact.comparisonUnavailableBody: The rest of the numbers on this page are up to date. Check again later.
impact.footnote: These numbers show how CareLoop works. They are not evidence of real-world results.

rungs.upcomingNoDate: If the step is still late

escalation.ackDoneNext: The case stays with the person responsible until the late step is done.
escalation.ackClosed: This escalation can no longer be acknowledged here.

escalation.confirmBody: This records that you have seen it. It does not change who is responsible or stop the clock: {owner} stays responsible, and the deadline stays the same.

ackFailed.conflict: This escalation was already acknowledged, or a newer one replaced it. Close this message to see the latest.
ackFailed.forbidden: Only {role} can acknowledge this escalation. Close this message to see the latest.
ackFailed.notFound: This case or escalation no longer exists.
ackFailed.error: Your acknowledgement could not be saved. Try again.

notices.acknowledgedDetail: Seen. The person responsible and the deadline stayed the same.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.notAvailable: Escalations will show here once they are switched on.
escalations.emptyBody: When a step is late, CareLoop reminds the person responsible, then tells the facility lead, then the programme coordinator. Nothing is escalated now.
escalations.emptyBodyCoordinator: A case shows here when an escalation reaches the programme coordinator. None has.
escalations.note: Acknowledging records that you have seen an escalation. It never changes who is responsible or stops the clock.

callOutcome.title: After a call with the patient
callOutcome.lede: A text message or email reply can only say "I got this message" or ask for a call. Record here what the patient told you on the phone.
callOutcome.willCome: The patient said they will come
callOutcome.saidBack: The patient said the next step back in their own words
callOutcome.confidence: How sure does the patient feel about what happens next?
callOutcome.scale: 1 is not sure, 5 is very sure.
callOutcome.notYet: Nothing can be recorded yet: no message has been sent to this patient.
callOutcome.note: Recording a call never changes who is responsible for the case.

failed.forbidden: Only a nurse navigator on this patient's team can record a call.
failed.conflict: The case changed while you were recording, and it has been read again. Anything already saved from this call is on the timeline below; check it before trying again.
failed.invalid: Tick at least one thing the patient said, and use a rating from 1 to 5.
failed.error: The call outcome could not be recorded. Try again.
